listing.name: Faces in the Void
listing.summary: Faces in the Void replaces all vanilla human portraits in Starsector. At this time, it also adds 178 additional generic human portraits. This is a work-in-progress with portraits being tweaked and replaced. Also, more bonus portraits will be added over time.
listing.aiSummary: Replaces all vanilla human portraits and adds 178 additional generic human portraits.

description:
Download Link:https://github.com/Moffhul/Starsector-Faces-in-the-Void/releases/download/v0.75-Faces-in-the-Void/Faces.in.the.Void_v0.75-beta.zip

All images are AI-generated.

Images were created using Midjourney AI and the vanilla portrait assets.
While I've put a lot of work into this and am proud of this mod so far, I make no claims of being an artist.
I just work with technology, have fiddled with AI, love this game and wanted to share.

Faces in the Void replaces all vanilla human portraits in Starsector. At this time, it also adds 178 additional generic human portraits.
This is a work-in-progress with portraits being tweaked and replaced. Also, more bonus portraits will be added over time.

v0.75 the Luddic Faith Born Anew
v0.75 includes 63 bonus portraits exclusive to the Luddic Faith and replaces the new portraits included in 0.98.5a. Also, small tweaks were made to some existing portraits.

New Luddic sheet:

Spoiler

New 098.5a Portraits:

Spoiler

v0.75 update notes

Spoiler
v0.75-beta 11/22/26
Starsector 0.98.5a compatible
NEW PORTRAITS:
Luddic Church:  Now adds 18 male and 15 female bonus portraits exclusive to the Luddic Church (up from 1 male and 2 female).
Luddic Path:    Now adds 17 male and 13 female bonus portraits exclusive to the Luddic Path (up from 3 male and 2 female).

0.98.5a New Portraits redone for Faces in the Void:
3 new Tritachyon portraits
8 new Defactioned portraits
13 new Character portraits
1 adjusted Sindrian Diktat portrait

EDITED:
Touched up several of the existing portraits in the process of redoing the new 98.5a portraits.
Removed more bloom. Continuing to find more... so much bloom...

The next release should focus on the Pirates and possibly some additional mercenaries.

This is the first mod I've ever released to others. Feedback is welcome.

Current portraits included in the mod:

Tri-tachyon and the Sindrian Diktat
